Question 2
?

Which integral expression gives the arc length of the curve g(t)=⟨sin⁡2t,cos⁡3t⟩ from t=0 to t=π?

a
∫0π4cos2⁡2t+9sin2⁡3tdt
b
 ∫012sin2⁡2t+9cos2⁡3tdt
c
 ∫0π4sin2⁡2t+9cos2⁡3tdt
d
 ∫012cos2⁡2t+3sin2⁡3tdt
e
 ∫0π2cos2⁡2t+9sin2⁡3tdt
